title: Independent electronic-structure investigation of Au···Au bonding in a tetranuclear gold(I) cation
category: computational inorganic chemistry / autonomous bonding investigation
difficulty_reasons: The agent must formulate and discriminate plausible bonding explanations for a heavy-atom tetracation.
The agent must select and validate an electronic-structure/AIM route without a disclosed author protocol.
Four individually identified Au···Au BCPs and multiple descriptors require coverage and computational provenance.

paper.title: Tetranuclear Gold(I) Complexes Bearing Imidazo[1,5-b]pyridazin-7-ylidene Ligands: Synthesis and Catalytic Applications in Nucleophilic Addition to Alkynes

data.description: Supplied immutable CCDC 2500223 CIF plus deterministic extraction/state definition for the anion-free tetranuclear Au(I) cation; CCDC retrieval is not scored.

required_deliverables.description: Hypothesis discrimination, validated calculation provenance, geometry/BCP checks, per-contact observables, conclusion.
